description: This file implements CRUD operations for the 'Product' entity, including functions to get, create, update, delete, and calculate total stock value, interacting with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM.

methods.name: Optional[Product] get(db: Session, product_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve a single product by its ID.

methods.name: List[Product] get_multi(db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Retrieve multiple products with optional pagination.

methods.name: Product create(db: Session, obj_in: ProductCreate)
methods.description: Create and save a new product to the database.

methods.name: Product update(db: Session, db_obj: Product, obj_in: ProductUpdate)
methods.description: Update fields of an existing product.

methods.name: Optional[Product] remove(db: Session, product_id: int)
methods.description: Delete a product by its ID and return the deleted object.

methods.name: float total_balance(db: Session)
methods.description: Calculate total monetary value of stock across all products by summing price * quantity using database aggregation.
